t: The Sylvania Toledo E27 GLS LED light bulb provides efficient and reliable illumination for various applications. This frosted, 7W LED bulb delivers 806 lumens of instant light, serving as a suitable replacement for older halogen, incandescent, and compact fluorescent lamps. With a good colour rendering index (CRI 80) and uniform light distribution, it ensures clear visibility and comfortable environments. Designed for longevity, it offers an average rated life of 15,000 hours, making it ideal for general purpose lighting in both residential and commercial properties, reducing the need for frequent replacements and maintenance costs.
